results.title: FSSAI Directs Pepsi, Red Bull and Other Brands to Remove ‘Energy Drink’ Label in 90 Days
results.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has instructed several beverage companies to discontinue the use of the term “energy drink” on their product labels within a timeframe of 90 days. results.title: Fast-track courts explained: Can paper leak cases get faster trials or face old delays?
results.description: Fast-track courts have existed in India for nearly 25 years. It was first introduced in 2000 to reduce the huge backlog of criminal cases after recommendations from the 11th Finance Commission.
